exam_scheme.note: UPCATET is a single-stage state entrance examination conducted rotationally by Uttar Pradesh's four State Agricultural Universities (SVPUAT Meerut, CSAUK Kanpur, ANDUAT Ayodhya, BUAT Banda). The Undergraduate entrance test consists of 200 objective MCQs carrying 600 marks (3 marks per question with 1 mark negative penalty) for 180 minutes.
